verdict: Breezy HR: Choose Breezy HR when you need a mid-market ATS with a usable free Bootstrap tier and clear paid pool pricing — not when the primary job is frontline scheduling, time clocks, or SOP training. Scores use the HR editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Clear ATS primary job with career site and interview workflows
Free forever Bootstrap for single-pool hiring
weaknesses: Free plan capped to one active pool
AI, SMS, Onboard, and Perform add-ons raise TCO
Not a WFM, time-clock, or SOP training product
Mobile strength is recruiting-oriented, not frontline WFM
bestFor: SMB and mid-market teams needing a dedicated ATS with transparent published pricing
Hiring teams that want a free Bootstrap plan to start with one active role
Buyers who prefer collaborative recruiting without buying a full HRIS suite
notIdealFor: Frontline ops teams whose primary job is shift scheduling or GPS clock-in
Orgs that need SOP training paths or an employee LMS as the primary purchase
High-volume enterprise ATS buyers who need Custom Pro features without sales engagement
tradeoffs: Published free tiers vs paid depth for ATS, WFM, time, or training jobs
Hub / multi-module pricing complexity vs single-product floors
Mobile/frontline readiness vs desk-bound admin depth
Opaque contact-sales pricing vs transparent published seats
recommendation: Choose Breezy HR when you need a mid-market ATS with a usable free Bootstrap tier and clear paid pool pricing — not when the primary job is frontline scheduling, time clocks, or SOP training. Compare Connecteam for frontline WFM, Jibble for time & attendance, and Trainual for SOP/employee training docs. Freshteam is a future ATS peer when onboarded — not forced in this wave.
editorialNotes: HR Wave-1 batch. Approved on hr-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=ats-recruiting. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Breezy positions recruiting pipelines and collaborative hiring for mid-market teams without heavy HRIS admin overhead. Score reflects first-party packaging and published onboarding posture, not hands-on lab testing.

Primary job is ATS/recruiting — pipelines, career site, interview scheduling, and candidate collaboration match the ats-recruiting cluster strongly. Scored inside ATS peers, not against WFM or time clocks.
Published hiring stages, pools/positions, interview scheduling, and career-site posting give solid ATS workflow depth for SMB–mid-market. Held at 8 vs deepest enterprise ATS suites.
Native Slack/Google Workspace/LinkedIn-style connectors plus Zapier-style automation support hire-to-retain stacks; not a full HRIS replacement.
Recruiting collaboration is available on mobile surfaces, but Breezy is not a deskless WFM/comms product — scored for recruiting mobility, not frontline shift ops.
Hiring reporting and pipeline analytics are marketed on paid tiers; depth is adequate for mid-market ATS buyers, not BI-suite depth.
Clear Bootstrap → Startup/Growth/Business → Custom Pro path with annual discounts supports growth; free pool limit is the main early constraint.
Meaningful free Bootstrap plus transparent annual floors ($157/$273/$439) are strong for ATS buyers; add-ons (Intelligence/SMS/Onboard) raise real TCO. Affiliate economics excluded.
Breezy Intelligence is a published AI add-on with credit packaging from ~$30/100k — useful capability with packaging friction rather than unlimited included AI.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS/recruiting, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
